note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: We are hiring 12 customer service agents for a new team, and 60 candidates have passed the phone screen.

answers.common.decision: How to schedule the panel interviews; the customer service manager approves every booking and candidate message.
answers.common.deadline: The new team starts next quarter.
answers.common.materials: Each candidate needs a one-hour panel interview with 2 managers. Our managers have 40 interview hours free between them over the next three weeks. Last round, 20% of booked candidates did not show up.
answers.people-hr.process: Panel interviews for customer service hiring, booked through our calendar system.
answers.people-hr.decider: The customer service manager approves every booking and decides who is hired.
